whatItIs: The fast that prepares for Genna, Ethiopian Christmas. It runs from Hidar 15 until the eve of Genna.
whyItMatters: It honours the prophets of the Old Testament, who waited and fasted for the coming of the Messiah. The church waits with them before celebrating His birth.
whatPeopleDo: Meals are fully plant-based: no meat, dairy or eggs
Many wait until midday or later before eating on weekdays
The fast ends with the Genna celebration on January 7
